title: SimpleTexting vs EZ Texting (2026): Which Is Actually Cheaper?

facts.fact: EZ Texting's entry plan starts at $20 per month.
facts.quote: EZ Texting starts at $20 a month. SimpleTexting starts at $29.

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan costs $20/mo for up to 500 contacts, with 6,000 credits per year and 1 user.
facts.quote: | Launch | **$20/mo** | Up to 500 | 6,000/year | 1 |

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Boost plan costs $60/mo for 500 to 2,000 contacts, with 6,000 credits per year and 1 user.
EZ Texting's Scale plan costs $100/mo for 2,000 to 50,000 contacts, with 6,000 credits per year and 1 user.
EZ Texting's Enterprise plan starts at $3,000/mo for 50,000+ contacts and 200,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: | Enterprise | **From $3,000/mo** | 50,000+ | 200,000/month | Custom |

facts.fact: EZ Texting advertises up to 20% off its plans for annual billing.
facts.quote: Those prices are the annual-billing rates. EZ Texting advertises up to 20% off for paying yearly.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's pricing is based on monthly credits, and the page says it runs nine tiers.
facts.quote: It runs nine tiers priced purely by how many credits you send in a month.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's 500-credit tier costs $29/mo on a toll-free number, or $39/mo on a local number.
facts.quote: That entry tier is **500 credits at $29 a month on a toll-free number**. A local number instead makes it $39

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's local number option adds a one-time $4 carrier registration fee that the toll-free option does not have.
facts.quote: adds a one-time $4 carrier registration fee that toll-free skips.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's largest listed tier is 50,000 credits for $899/mo, or 1.8 cents per message.
SimpleTexting offers 20% off for yearly payment and 15% off for nonprofits.
facts.quote: Paying yearly saves 20%, and nonprofits get 15% off.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting contacts are unlimited on every tier, and unused credits roll over to the end of the following month.
facts.quote: **Contacts are unlimited on every tier**, no matter which one you are on, and unused credits roll over to the end of the following month.

facts.fact: One SMS of up to 160 characters costs one SimpleTexting credit, an extended message up to 306 characters costs 2, and an MMS costs 3.
facts.quote: One SMS up to 160 characters is one credit, an extended message up to 306 characters is 2, and an MMS is 3.

facts.fact: EZ Texting's overage charge is 4 cents per message on Launch, 3.5 cents on Boost, 3 cents on Scale, and 1 cent on Enterprise.
facts.quote: EZ Texting charges overage per message: 4 cents on Launch, 3.5 cents on Boost, 3 cents on Scale, and 1 cent on Enterprise.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting includes 3 users on its entry configuration, and each extra user costs $20/mo.
facts.quote: **Users included** | **3** (extra $20/mo)

facts.fact: EZ Texting includes 1 user on its Launch, Boost, and Scale plans.
facts.quote: EZ Texting gives you 1, all the way up through the $100 Scale plan.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers a 14-day free trial that requires no credit card.
facts.quote: | Free trial | **14 days, no card** | Not published |

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, while EZ Texting's refund policy is not published.
facts.quote: | Money-back | 30 days | Not published |

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan is subject to a telecom fee whose amount is not published, while Boost and Scale have it waived.
facts.quote: EZ Texting’s $20 Launch plan is subject to a telecom fee that Boost and Scale have waived. The amount is not published

facts.fact: The page's ClickSend and SimpleTexting totals include a carrier fee of roughly 0.42 cents per message.
facts.quote: ClickSend and SimpleTexting totals include their roughly 0.42 cent per-message carrier fee

facts.fact: The page's SimpleTexting prices were verified direct from the vendor on 25 August 2026.
facts.quote: Prices verified direct from each vendor, US rates: SimpleTexting 25 August 2026

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's 500-credit tier at $29/mo equals about 5.8 cents per message.
EZ Texting's 6,000 annual credits equal about 500 messages per month.
facts.quote: **That works out to 500 messages a month**, which is exactly the same allowance as SimpleTexting’s $29 entry bundle.

facts.fact: SlickText starts at $29 a month for 500 credits, according to the page's comparison note.
facts.quote: which starts at $29 a month for the same 500 credits

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan costs $20 a month.
facts.quote: EZ Texting’s Launch plan is $20 a month against SimpleTexting’s $29 entry configuration.

facts.fact: EZ Texting moves contacts above 500 to its Boost plan at $60 a month.
facts.quote: Above 500 contacts EZ Texting moves you to Boost at $60 a month

facts.fact: At 10,000 contacts, EZ Texting costs $100 a month, while SimpleTexting costs $29 a month.
facts.quote: At 10,000 contacts EZ Texting costs $100 a month and SimpleTexting still costs $29.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting does not charge by contact count.
facts.quote: because it does not charge by contact count

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch, Boost and Scale plans each include 6,000 credits per year, which the page says equals 500 messages a month.
facts.quote: The Launch, Boost and Scale plans all include 6,000 credits per year, which works out to 500 messages a month.

facts.fact: EZ Texting Enterprise plans include 200,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Enterprise plans include 200,000 credits per month.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting runs nine tiers priced by monthly credit volume, from 500 credits at $29 a month to 50,000 credits at $899 a month.
facts.quote: SimpleTexting removed named plans and now runs nine tiers priced purely by monthly credit volume, from 500 credits at $29 a month up to 50,000 credits at $899

facts.fact: On SimpleTexting, a local number adds $10 a month plus a one-time $4 registration fee, while the toll-free number is free.
facts.quote: a local number adds $10 a month and a one-time $4 registration

facts.fact: EZ Texting caps contacts at 500 on Launch, 2,000 on Boost and 50,000 on Scale.
facts.quote: EZ Texting caps contacts by plan: 500 on Launch, 2,000 on Boost, 50,000 on Scale

facts.fact: EZ Texting's quote-only Enterprise plan starts at $3,000 a month.
facts.quote: you need a quote-only Enterprise plan starting at $3,000 a month.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's contacts are unlimited on every configuration.
facts.quote: Contacts are unlimited on every configuration

facts.fact: SimpleTexting charges 5.5 cents per extra credit on its 500-credit tier, 5 cents at 1,000 and 4 cents at 2,000.
facts.quote: SimpleTexting charges 5.5 cents for extra credits on its 500 tier, falling to 5 cents at 1,000 and 4 cents at 2,000

facts.fact: SimpleTexting includes 3 user seats on every configuration, with extra users at $20 a month each.
facts.unit: USD per month per extra user
facts.quote: SimpleTexting includes 3 user seats on every configuration, with extra users at $20 a month each.

facts.fact: EZ Texting includes 1 user on its Launch, Boost and Scale plans.
facts.quote: EZ Texting includes 1 user on the Launch, Boost and Scale plans.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required and a 30-day money-back guarantee on paid plans.
facts.quote: SimpleTexting offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee on paid plans.

facts.fact: EZ Texting says accounts are set up within one business day.
facts.quote: says accounts are set up within one business day
